items.title: Welcome Back to a New Academic Year
items.body: We are excited to welcome all our students back for another year of learning and inspiration at Dr. Abraham S. Borbor Memorial School Of Excellence. Classes resume on schedule and we look forward to a year of academic growth, character building, and community.

items.title: 2024–2025 Graduation Highlights
items.body: Congratulations to our recent graduates who have shown exceptional dedication and hard work. The Class of 2024–2025 marks another milestone for our growing school community in Mount Barclay, Liberia.
